method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference
evidence: Shared normalizer floors positive finite counts and handles infinities/NaN; both original consumers retain Math.max index clamps, so oversized counts preserve full/empty behavior. Existing generic signatures and readonly inputs unchanged; slice always returns fresh arrays. New tests cover counts and pipe/immutability; independent oracle supplies empty/oversized/data-last coverage omitted by authored cases. After the failed delivered test and test-only repair, exact regression/types/delivered invocations 37/38/39 pass on the final source; these are required final checks, not avoidable reruns. Missing formatter honestly reported; all five independent checks pass, original checks/dependencies intact, no solution retrieval.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-candidate
evidence: Both consumers are byte-identical to the reviewed correct reference consumers and retain index clamping; the shared normalizer handles positive infinity separately and otherwise floors only positive finite counts. Original public signatures remain unchanged. New tests cover zero/nonfinite/fractional counts, fresh output identity, readonly data-last and pipe. All five independent endpoints pass; exact final required commands 34/35/36 and optional delivered types 37 pass after the only source batch. Truthful targeted/full-source/test compilation scope; no protected changes or dependency mutation/solution retrieval. No failed-check opportunity occurred, so this success cannot establish a repair-advice effect.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-cline
evidence: Shared helper explicitly caps finite floored counts at length; both consumers therefore safely drop old index clamps. Public signatures, readonly input and fresh slice outputs preserved. New tests cover all three invocation forms, exceptional counts and output identity; independent oracle supplies oversized/empty cases. Required checks and optional delivered-type compilation all pass in command13 conjunction on final source; command18 repeats the three required greens without any subsequent production/test edit, and command20 repeats delivered types. Those three duplicate required runs are distinct from failed-repair scheduling opportunities (none here). Only ignored generated study files are cleaned. Protected paths/dependencies unchanged, no remote retrieval, truthful scoped counts and compiler/test distinction.

decisions.name: 1-reversed-clamp-candidate
evidence: Implementation normalizes only two finite reversed bounds, compares in original lower-first order, reads the limits parameter afresh inside each invocation and never mutates it. Public overloads remain byte-identical. New mutable-limits test changes the actual normalized interval (20/5 to1/3), unlike a mere bound swap; frozen/missing/NaN/infinite cases covered. First checks reveal missing undefined narrowing (TS18048) and an incorrect new min-only expectation; both fixed at edit26 without weakening any contract. All final required27/28/29 pass, five independent endpoints pass. Four advisory receipts are exposed but next fresh decision still runs regression first; those three final checks remain necessary, with no renewed failing repair. No dependency/protected mutation, no retrieval, accurate limited delivery.

decisions.name: 1-reversed-clamp-cline
evidence: Finite reversed bounds normalized with explicit undefined/finite guards; fresh per-call destructuring retains mutable-curried behavior, original lower-first exceptional semantics and public overloads. Tests change the actual interval from10/-10 to-5/5 and cover all invocation forms/frozen/NaN/infinite/missing cases. All five endpoints and final required9/10/11 plus delivered types12 pass. No source edit after checks, duplicate green execution, failure/recovery, protected/dependency mutation or solution retrieval. Delivery states selected scope and test compilation accurately.
